policy_text: SLA-breached premium customers may receive up to INR 1000 goodwill credit and priority escalation.
Standard customers may receive up to INR 500 goodwill credit for verified carrier delays.
Refunds above INR 1000 require human approval and evidence of eligibility.
Orders not dispatched may be cancelled automatically when policy eligibility is confirmed.
Legal, safety, fraud or regulatory complaints require human review.
